name: Attar Bazaar
tagline: Oud, saffron and resin — the souk an hour after sundown.

detail.story: Built the way a mukhallat is built — no alcohol, no filler, oil layered on oil until it stops smelling like ingredients. Saffron and cardamom sit on top for the first half hour; underneath, oud and labdanum do not move for the rest of the day. It is loud in the way old Gulf perfumery is loud: not sharp, just unmistakably present.
detail.wear: A single touch at the wrist. Attars are concentrated oil — more is not better, and it will still be there tomorrow.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Extrait de parfum — about 30% aromatic compound in alcohol or oil. The most concentrated form sold, and the reason a single touch is enough.

name: Golden Resin
tagline: Benzoin and frankincense melted into honey and left in the sun.

detail.story: An amber that leans sweet rather than smoky. Benzoin and vanillin are doing most of the work, with frankincense keeping it from turning into dessert. It sits close for the first hour and then blooms — most people notice it on you before you do.
detail.wear: Two sprays at the chest. On skin rather than clothing — amber needs warmth to open.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de parfum — about 22% aromatic compound. The usual strength for something meant to last a working day.

name: Smoke Over the Souk
tagline: Guaiac smoke drifting over cypriol and cold incense.

detail.story: Guaiacol is nearly pure smoke, and used carelessly it smells like an accident. Here it sits under frankincense and cypriol so it reads as a fire that has been out for an hour rather than one still burning. The driest thing in the collection.
detail.wear: One touch at the throat. It grows for twenty minutes before it settles — judge it then, not at first.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Extrait de parfum — about 28% aromatic compound. Dense, slow to open, and long past the point where more would help.

name: Rose Oud Attar
tagline: Damask rose laid over oud in a bed of jojoba.

detail.story: The oldest pairing in Arabic perfumery and the hardest to make new. The rose here is kept green and slightly sharp rather than jammy, so the oud has something to push against instead of drowning in sugar.
detail.wear: A single touch. Rose-oud rewards restraint more than any other pairing.
similarTo: Frederic Malle Portrait of a Lady

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Attar — 100% aromatic compound in a carrier oil, with no alcohol at all. It does not spray and it does not flash off; it is touched on and it stays.

name: Bergamot Cologne
tagline: Cold bergamot and petitgrain, poured straight over ice.

detail.story: A cologne in the old sense — built to be splashed on and to disappear. The pleasure is the first twenty minutes, and it is not pretending otherwise. Petitgrain and clary sage keep it from being just lemon.
detail.wear: Generously, and again after lunch. This is one to over-apply.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de cologne — about 12% aromatic compound. Deliberately light: a cologne is meant to be splashed on and to fade, and this one is honest about that.

name: Space Wood
tagline: Vetiver roots and cedar suspended in weightless amber-wood.

detail.story: Almost nothing, on purpose. Iso E Super and a musk, and very little else. It fades in and out of your own perception — you will lose it and then catch it again an hour later, which is exactly the effect. Some people cannot smell it at all.
detail.wear: Three or four sprays — more than feels sensible. It is quiet up close and carries surprisingly far.
similarTo: Juliette Has a Gun Not a Perfume

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de parfum — about 20% aromatic compound. Strong enough to last, light enough to wear anywhere.

name: Skin Musk Halo
tagline: The invisible one. Reads as skin, never as perfume.

detail.story: The 'you but better' one. A trace of civet keeps it from smelling like fabric softener, which is where most clean musks end up. Worn close, it reads as skin rather than as perfume — which is either the point or a disappointment, depending on what you wanted.
detail.wear: Anywhere, freely. It is the one in the collection that cannot be overdone.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de parfum — about 18% aromatic compound. Toward the lighter end, which suits a composition built to stay close.

name: Salt Lemon
tagline: Lemon peel and sea air, over nothing at all.

detail.story: Most citrus perfumes apologise for being brief by loading the base with wood. This one does not. It is lemon, salt and a breath of moss, and when it goes it goes cleanly.
detail.wear: Splash it on. This is not a perfume to be careful with.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Cologne — the lightest thing that is still a perfume. It is meant to be splashed on and reapplied, not rationed.

name: Green Mandarin Hour
tagline: Mandarin picked early, while the peel is still green.

detail.story: The fruit before it is sweet. Mandarin taken at the point where the rind is still bitter, propped up with basil so the greenness has somewhere to go.
detail.wear: Two sprays on the chest, where the warmth keeps the citrus alive longer.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Toilette — enough oil to last a working day and light enough to wear in heat.

name: Neroli in Shade
tagline: Orange blossom with the sun taken off it.

detail.story: Neroli is usually written as sunlight. Here it is kept cool and a little soapy, the way the flower actually smells at dusk rather than at noon.
detail.wear: On the throat. Neroli is at its best where the skin is warmest.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Parfum — the standard modern strength. Two sprays is a decision; four is an announcement.

name: Galbanum Cut
tagline: A stem snapped in half, and the sap still on your hands.

detail.story: Galbanum is the most uncompromising green there is, and most perfumes soften it immediately. This one waits. The florals arrive late and stay behind it.
detail.wear: One spray, and let it settle for ten minutes before deciding.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Parfum — the standard modern strength. Two sprays is a decision; four is an announcement.

name: Fig Tree Noon
tagline: The whole tree — leaf, milk and fruit.

detail.story: A fig perfume that is mostly leaf. The fruit is there, but it sits underneath the green and the milk rather than being the point of the thing.
detail.wear: Anywhere. This is a comfortable perfume and hard to overdo.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Toilette — enough oil to last a working day and light enough to wear in heat.

name: Wet Stone Morning
tagline: The minute before rain, held for six hours.

detail.story: Petrichor is a trick that usually lasts twenty minutes. Holding it takes a mineral base that has no sweetness in it anywhere, which is most of the work here.
detail.wear: Two sprays. It reads quiet and lasts much longer than it announces.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Parfum — the standard modern strength. Two sprays is a decision; four is an announcement.

name: Damask at Dawn
tagline: Roses cut before the sun is on them.

detail.story: A rose taken at the hour it is actually picked — cold, wet and faintly green, before the heat brings the jam out of it.
detail.wear: Two sprays. A rose this green does not need to be rationed.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Parfum — the standard modern strength. Two sprays is a decision; four is an announcement.

name: Tuberose After Dark
tagline: The flower at the hour it is loudest.

detail.story: Tuberose is enormous and there is no point pretending otherwise. This leans in — creamy, faintly rubbery, and unapologetic about the room it takes.
detail.wear: One spray. Two if you mean it, and you will be asked about it.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Extrait — very little alcohol and a great deal of oil. It sits close and lasts, and one touch is a wearing.

name: Iris in Cold Rooms
tagline: Orris root, and the room it was kept in.

detail.story: Iris butter is cold, rooty and faintly of earth, and it costs more than anything else on the bench. Nothing here is asked to make it warmer than it is.
detail.wear: One touch. Iris is a perfume for standing close to somebody.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Extrait — very little alcohol and a great deal of oil. It sits close and lasts, and one touch is a wearing.

name: Jasmine and Tea
tagline: Jasmine dried into tea leaves rather than picked fresh.

detail.story: Fresh jasmine is animal and slightly rude. Dried into tea it becomes something else — quieter, drier, and much easier to wear for a whole day.
detail.wear: Two sprays. It sits close and rewards being found rather than announced.
similarTo: Bulgari Eau Parfumée au Thé Vert

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Parfum — the standard modern strength. Two sprays is a decision; four is an announcement.

name: Osmanthus Apricot Skin
tagline: A flower that smells of apricot skin and old leather.

detail.story: Osmanthus does something no other flower manages — it smells of fruit and of hide at the same time. The formula gets out of its way and lets both sides show.
detail.wear: Two sprays on the throat. The leather comes up with warmth.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Parfum — the standard modern strength. Two sprays is a decision; four is an announcement.

name: Oakmoss and Plum
tagline: Dark fruit over a wet forest floor.

detail.story: A chypre in the old sense — bergamot at the top, moss at the bottom, and something dark and jammy holding the middle together.
detail.wear: Two sprays. Chypres need a moment to stop being sharp.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Parfum — the standard modern strength. Two sprays is a decision; four is an announcement.

name: Leather Chypre Club
tagline: A leather jacket that has been somewhere.

detail.story: Birch tar is a bully and most modern leathers sand it down to suede. This does not — it keeps the smoke and gives it moss to stand on.

longevity.label: All day and into the night

detail.wear: One touch. Leather is a perfume you should have to lean in for.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Extrait — very little alcohol and a great deal of oil. It sits close and lasts, and one touch is a wearing.

name: Vetiver and Moss
tagline: Roots, moss, and the smell of rain on gravel.

detail.story: Vetiver is a root and smells like one — smoky, earthy and faintly grapefruit. Pairing it with moss is obvious and almost nobody does it properly any more.
detail.wear: Two sprays. Vetiver improves for the first half hour.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Parfum — the standard modern strength. Two sprays is a decision; four is an announcement.

name: Sandalwood Milk
tagline: Sandalwood with the milk left in.

detail.story: Real sandalwood is quiet and creamy and nearly gone from the world. This uses both — the wood where it counts, and a molecule that carries it further than the wood can afford to.
detail.wear: One touch on the wrist. It is a perfume for being close to.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Extrait — very little alcohol and a great deal of oil. It sits close and lasts, and one touch is a wearing.

name: Cedar and Cold Air
tagline: A pencil sharpener and an open window.

detail.story: Cedar on its own is thin. Given cold air and a little pepper it becomes upright and rather severe, which is the whole intention.
detail.wear: Two sprays. It is a quiet perfume and can take them.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Toilette — enough oil to last a working day and light enough to wear in heat.

name: Guaiac and Ash
tagline: The fire an hour after it went out.

detail.story: Guaiac wood smells of smoke and roses at once, which is a strange gift. The formula keeps the smoke and lets the rose stay implied.
detail.wear: One spray. Smoke travels on its own.
similarTo: Comme des Garçons Bois et Fruits

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Parfum — the standard modern strength. Two sprays is a decision; four is an announcement.

name: Patchouli Without Mud
tagline: The chocolate half of patchouli, without the head shop.

detail.story: Patchouli has two halves — damp earth and dark chocolate — and most perfumes get both whether they want them or not. This one takes the chocolate.
detail.wear: One spray. Patchouli has a long reach.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Parfum — the standard modern strength. Two sprays is a decision; four is an announcement.

name: Oud and Cold Rose
tagline: Rose kept cold so the oud has something to lean on.

detail.story: The pairing everyone attempts. The only decision that matters is whether the rose is warm or cold, and warm rose plus oud is a jam. This one is cold.

longevity.label: All day and into the night

detail.wear: A single touch on the pulse. Attar does not need a second.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Attar — 100% aromatic compound in a carrier oil, with no alcohol at all. It does not spray and it does not flash off; it is touched on and it stays.

name: Oud and Honey
tagline: Honey with the beehive still attached.

detail.story: Honey in perfume is never only sweet — there is always something faintly barnyard in it. Next to oud that becomes the point rather than a problem.

longevity.label: All day and into the night

detail.wear: A single touch, and wash your hands afterwards.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Attar — 100% aromatic compound in a carrier oil, with no alcohol at all. It does not spray and it does not flash off; it is touched on and it stays.

name: Incense Road
tagline: Cold church incense, and the stone it was burnt on.

detail.story: Frankincense is bright and lemony before it is holy. Kept cold and dry, with myrrh underneath, it turns into something closer to architecture than to worship.

longevity.label: All day and into the night

detail.wear: One touch. Incense fills whatever room it is in.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Attar — 100% aromatic compound in a carrier oil, with no alcohol at all. It does not spray and it does not flash off; it is touched on and it stays.

name: Saffron and Leather
tagline: Saffron rubbed into a new saddle.

detail.story: Saffron is medicinal, leathery and faintly rubbery on its own — which is why it and leather belong together and why so few perfumes bother.

longevity.label: All day and into the night

detail.wear: A single touch. This is a loud perfume in a small bottle.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Attar — 100% aromatic compound in a carrier oil, with no alcohol at all. It does not spray and it does not flash off; it is touched on and it stays.

name: Labdanum Hearth
tagline: The warm corner of a cold house.

detail.story: Labdanum is the animal in amber — leathery, sweet and faintly of the goat it was combed from. Everything else here exists to keep it comfortable.
detail.wear: Two sprays on the chest, under a coat.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Parfum — the standard modern strength. Two sprays is a decision; four is an announcement.

name: Myrrh and Cold Stone
tagline: Bitter resin in an unheated room.

detail.story: Myrrh is the bitter one — medicinal, cool and slightly mushroom. It is usually sweetened into submission. Here it is simply given space.
detail.wear: Two sprays. Myrrh takes twenty minutes to become itself.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Parfum — the standard modern strength. Two sprays is a decision; four is an announcement.

name: Tobacco and Tolu
tagline: A tobacco pouch, opened.

detail.story: Not a cigarette — the leaf in the pouch, which is sweet, dry and hay-like. Tolu balsam agrees with it so completely that very little else is needed.
detail.wear: Two sprays. It is warmer on wool than on skin.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Parfum — the standard modern strength. Two sprays is a decision; four is an announcement.

name: Immortelle and Salt
tagline: Maple syrup, hay and the sea somewhere behind.

detail.story: Immortelle smells of maple syrup and curry leaf and nothing else does. Salt keeps it from becoming a dessert, which is where it always wants to go.
detail.wear: One spray. Immortelle is not a shy material.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Parfum — the standard modern strength. Two sprays is a decision; four is an announcement.

name: Burnt Sugar and Rum
tagline: Caramel taken one minute past ready.

detail.story: Sweetness is easy and boring. Sugar cooked until it is bitter is neither, and rum gives it the spirit edge that stops the whole thing being a pudding.
detail.wear: One spray. Gourmands carry much further than they seem to.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Parfum — the standard modern strength. Two sprays is a decision; four is an announcement.

name: Bitter Cocoa Dust
tagline: Cocoa before anybody has added sugar to it.

detail.story: Cocoa absolute is bitter and dusty and smells nothing like chocolate as a sweet. Patchouli agrees with it completely; vanilla is kept well back.
detail.wear: One spray. It is drier than it sounds and better for it.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Parfum — the standard modern strength. Two sprays is a decision; four is an announcement.

name: Coffee and Cardamom
tagline: The cup you are handed before anybody speaks.

detail.story: Cardamom in coffee is not a flourish, it is how it is made across half the world. The perfume follows the drink rather than a dessert menu.
detail.wear: Two sprays in the morning, which is the only correct time.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Parfum — the standard modern strength. Two sprays is a decision; four is an announcement.

name: Clean Linen Musk
tagline: A shirt off the line, an hour after the sun went in.

detail.story: The cleanest thing here, and deliberately almost nothing. Aldehyde, musk and a trace of iris — a perfume for people who do not want to smell of a perfume.
detail.wear: Three sprays. Clean musks are meant to be worn generously.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Toilette — enough oil to last a working day and light enough to wear in heat.

name: Warm Skin Musk
tagline: The back of somebody's neck.

detail.story: There is a line between skin and unwashed and it is thinner than anyone admits. Cumin is here in a trace — enough to make it human, not enough to make it a problem.
detail.wear: Two sprays, and let somebody find it rather than announcing it.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Parfum — the standard modern strength. Two sprays is a decision; four is an announcement.

name: Ambrette and Cotton
tagline: The only plant that smells like a musk.

detail.story: Ambrette seed is pear skin, warm cotton and something faintly of the body, and it is the one musk that grows rather than being made. It carries the whole perfume.
detail.wear: Three sprays. Ambrette is quiet and does not mind repetition.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Parfum — the standard modern strength. Two sprays is a decision; four is an announcement.

name: Low Tide Iodine
tagline: The sea as it actually smells, which is not like laundry.

detail.story: Marine perfumes mostly smell of clean sheets. Real coast is iodine, salt and something faintly rotting, and that is what this is after.
detail.wear: Two sprays. It is sharper in the first ten minutes than afterwards.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Toilette — enough oil to last a working day and light enough to wear in heat.

name: Salt on Warm Skin
tagline: What the sea leaves behind once it has dried.

detail.story: Ambergris is the smell of salt on skin more than of the ocean itself. Warm, papery and slightly sweet, and it makes everything near it smell like the person wearing it.
detail.wear: Two sprays. It gets better as the day gets warmer.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Parfum — the standard modern strength. Two sprays is a decision; four is an announcement.

name: Lavender Barbershop
tagline: A hot towel and a cold mirror.

detail.story: The oldest structure in men's perfumery — lavender over coumarin over moss — and it has not been improved on. This one keeps the moss.
detail.wear: Two sprays after shaving, which is what it was built for.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Toilette — enough oil to last a working day and light enough to wear in heat.

name: Rosemary and Salt Air
tagline: A hillside above the sea, in full sun.

detail.story: Rosemary, juniper and salt — a herb garden with weather in it. Nothing sweet anywhere, which is unusual for something this easy to wear.
detail.wear: Three sprays. It is built to be reapplied.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Toilette — enough oil to last a working day and light enough to wear in heat.

name: Blackcurrant and Thorn
tagline: Cassis, and the bush it was picked off.

detail.story: Blackcurrant bud is sharp and faintly catty, and used properly it is one of the best top notes there is. The bramble underneath keeps it from turning into squash.
detail.wear: Two sprays. The cassis burns off fast and the moss is the point.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Parfum — the standard modern strength. Two sprays is a decision; four is an announcement.

name: Clove and Carnation
tagline: A flower that smells of the spice cupboard.

detail.story: Carnation is mostly clove, which is why the two are impossible to separate and why nobody has made this properly since the nineteen-forties.
detail.wear: One spray. Clove is stronger than it tastes.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Parfum — the standard modern strength. Two sprays is a decision; four is an announcement.

name: Pepper and Paper
tagline: Black pepper, ground onto something dry.

detail.story: Pepper is usually a flourish at the top of a perfume and gone in five minutes. Given papyrus and a dry musk it stays for the afternoon.
detail.wear: Two sprays. Quiet, and closer to a texture than a smell.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Toilette — enough oil to last a working day and light enough to wear in heat.

name: Ginger and Green Tea
tagline: Fizzy at the top, bitter underneath.

detail.story: Ginger behaves like a citrus rather than a spice — bright, fizzy and gone quickly. Green tea catches it on the way down and makes it last.
detail.wear: Three sprays. It is designed to be light and reapplied.
similarTo: Bulgari Eau Parfumée au Thé Vert

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de Toilette — enough oil to last a working day and light enough to wear in heat.

name: Treasure Chest
tagline: Old wood, old leather, and something spiced still hiding inside.

detail.story: A chest that hasn't been opened in decades: dry cedar and cracked leather hinges first, then the oud and labdanum that never left, and a last trace of spice that got sealed in with everything else. It doesn't announce itself — it sits, the way old wood sits.
detail.wear: Two sprays at the chest. It needs skin warmth to open the leather.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de parfum — about 20% aromatic compound. Built to last a full day without reapplying.

name: Raised From the Deep
tagline: Salt, algae, and cold metal — pulled up before it dried.

detail.story: Not the beach — the thing that comes up from below it. Salt and cold mineral first, barnacled and briny, then a wet-stone base that stays damp long after everything else has dried out. Ambroxan does the heavy lifting: dry, saline, and a little metallic, the way old silver goes when the sea gets to it.
detail.wear: Two sprays at the wrist and collarbone. Reads best on bare skin, not fabric.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de parfum — about 18% aromatic compound, kept light so the marine top notes stay bright.

name: The Treasure Map
tagline: Parchment, dust, and ink that hasn't fully dried.

detail.story: The smell of a folded, refolded piece of paper — dry orris and cedar for the parchment and pencil, frankincense for the dust in the air above it, and a last edge of something inky that never quite fades. Built to smell like a document, not a flower pressed inside one.
detail.wear: Two sprays at the wrist. A dry scent — give it a few minutes before judging it.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de parfum — about 20% aromatic compound, held dry and powdery rather than sweet.

name: Paper Money
tagline: Cotton-linen paper, fresh ink, counted twice.

detail.story: Not banknotes as metaphor — the actual cotton-linen paper they're printed on, plus the ink smell of a note fresh off a stack. Aldehydes give it that clean, slightly metallic crispness; iris and cedar keep it dry rather than soapy.
detail.wear: Two sprays at the chest. Reads clean and slightly starched.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de parfum — about 18% aromatic compound, kept light to stay crisp rather than powdery.

name: Loose Change
tagline: Cold coins in your palm, warmed by the hour.

detail.story: The closest thing to a smell that isn't really one — the impression coins leave on skin. Sharp metallic aldehydes up top, cold and a little bloodless, warming into a mineral, slightly salty base as it sits. Meant to feel handled, not shiny.
detail.wear: One spray at the wrist — this one is meant to stay close.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de parfum — about 18% aromatic compound. Deliberately understated; this is a skin scent.

name: Gold & Jewels
tagline: Warm amber, honeyed resin, and saffron catching the light.

detail.story: The most openly opulent thing in the collection, and it knows it. Saffron and rose up top, then labdanum and benzoin melt into something honeyed and radiant that doesn't let up. Frankincense keeps it from tipping into dessert. This is the one built to be noticed.
detail.wear: Two sprays at the chest. Loud by design — wear it when you want to be found.

sizes.label: Discovery
sizes.note: Enough for a fortnight of wearing.

detail.concentrationNote: Eau de parfum — about 22% aromatic compound. Built for maximum radiance and throw.

name: Charcoal & Char

name: First Rain, Friday Feast
tagline: Wet earth and cardamom smoke — the two things that mean the week is over.

detail.story: The rain lands first — real Kannauj clay attar and geosmin, not a synthetic ozone guess. Underneath it, cardamom and saffron for the pot already on the stove, guaiacol at trace for the seared edge of frying spice, a ghee-rich lactone for the fat in the pan, and civet at an almost-nothing dose for the savoury depth no gourmand accord usually bothers with. This is an impression of a very specific Friday, not a replica of a curry — food doesn't translate to fragrance one-to-one, but this is the closest this palette gets. Built around Attar Mitti, Geosmin (0.1% working dilution), Cardamom Oil RCO.

detail.story: Whole spice first — cardamom, clove, black pepper, the way they go into the pot before the meat does. No literal meat note exists in fine fragrance — this gets close by leaning on the same spice-and-warmth architecture the kitchen itself is built on.
